details.effect: [evolve][cost02]: Evolve this follower. [fanfare] Search your deck for a spell, reveal it, and add it to your hand.

issues: The fanfare search is incorrectly encoded with searchDeckChoose; it should use tutorFromDeck with filter {"cardType":"spell"}, to "hand", and reveal true to represent searching your deck for any spell and adding it to your hand.

details.effect: [act] [engage], put a Marine card from your hand into your EX area: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it damage equal to the number of Marine followers on your field.

effect.label: put a Marine card from your hand into your EX area

issues: The card incorrectly has the keyword fanfare; remove that keyword because the source only has an activated ability.
The activated ability is incorrectly set to activateFrom "hand"; it should activate from the field.

The cost should require putting a Marine card from your hand into your EX area, not an optional additional cost; encode the hand-to-EX action as part of the activated ability's required cost/effect sequence rather than optionalCost.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: When playing this, [engage] a Marine follower on your field: This costs 2 less to play. ---------- Select an enemy follower on the field. Engage it and draw a card. It doesn't refresh during its controller's next start phase.

effect.label: [engage] a Marine follower on your field

issues: The card incorrectly has the keyword quick; remove it because the source does not have [quick].

The cost-reduction clause is encoded as a spell ability with optionalCost and engageSelf, but it should target and engage a Marine follower on your field when playing this card; engageSelf is incorrect and this is not a separate spell effect.
The main spell effect should not have quick: true.

The cost-reduction mechanic 'When playing this, engage a Marine follower on your field: This costs 2 less to play' is not faithfully represented as a play-time cost modifier tied to engaging a Marine follower.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this. Whenever another Marine follower is put onto your field, deal 1 damage to each enemy leader.

issues: The trigger should be 'another Marine follower' entering your field; add exclusion so this card does not trigger on itself.
The triggered effect is incorrect: dealDamageAllEnemies damages enemy followers and leader, but the source says to deal 1 damage to each enemy leader only; encode damage only to enemy leaders.
